buildCmd: npx nx run front:build && cp dist/apps/front/assets/index-*.css apps/front/.ds-styles.css && (cd apps/front && ../../node_modules/.bin/tsc -p tsconfig.ds-types.json)

dtsPropsFor.EmptyState: /** EmptyState takes no props — the copy is fixed to the agents-list empty state. */
dtsPropsFor.JobStateBadge:
/** Raw job state from the hub — underscores are formatted to spaces internally. */
state: 'accepted' | 'pulling_image' | 'creating_container' | 'starting_container' | 'running' | 'stopping' | 'cancelled' | 'succeeded' | 'failed' | 'timed_out';
